<!-- generated by npm run docs:generate; do not edit -->

Admin routes of the roles module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/roles

List all roles

Responses:

- `200`: Roles retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/roles

Create new role

Request body: [CreateRoleDto](#createroledto).

Responses:

- `201`: Role created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## PATCH /v1/admin/roles/{id}

Update role permissions

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateRolePermissionsDto](#updaterolepermissionsdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Role permissions updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Role not found.
